title: Load the portfolio home page
description: A visitor can open the main portfolio landing page and see the core homepage content rendered.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the homepage content is displayed
Verify the main portfolio navigation or featured content is visible

title: Submit a lead inquiry successfully
description: A potential client can complete the contact form with valid details and see the success confirmation after submission.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Fill in the name field with a valid name
Fill in the email field with a valid email address
Select a budget tier
Fill in the message field with an inquiry message
Submit the contact form
Verify a success confirmation is visible
Verify the transmission result is shown to the user

title: Update the region and see pricing adapt
description: A visitor can change country and currency and see the region-specific header and pricing details update together.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the country and currency selector
Choose a different country and currency
Verify the header region indicator updates
Verify the hero pricing hint and contact budget options update

title: Switch to the alternate theme
description: A visitor can toggle the site into the alternate visual theme and confirm the page restyles correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Toggle the theme switch
Verify the site styling changes to the alternate theme
Verify the layout and main content remain visible

title: Keep regional pricing consistent across the page
description: A visitor can select a region and see the updated pricing language remain consistent in the main pricing areas of the page.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the country and currency selector
Choose a different country and currency
Scroll to the pricing-related content
Verify regional pricing text is displayed in the page content
Verify the selected currency is reflected consistently

title: Return to the original theme
description: A visitor can toggle back to the original theme after switching themes and the site returns to its initial appearance.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Toggle the theme switch
Toggle the theme switch again
Verify the site styling returns to the original theme
Verify the homepage content remains visible

title: Explore the featured portfolio presentation
description: A visitor can browse the landing page presentation and see the featured content and interactive visuals appear correctly.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll through the main landing page
Verify featured portfolio content is displayed
Verify interactive visual elements are present

title: Preserve the selected region while continuing to browse
description: A visitor can change the region and continue exploring the page with the selected currency still reflected in the visible session state.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Open the country and currency selector
Choose a different country and currency
Scroll to another section of the page
Verify the selected region is still reflected in the page header
Verify the updated currency remains visible in the session state

title: Show validation for an incomplete inquiry
description: A potential client sees form validation when required contact details are missing before submission.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Leave the required contact fields empty
Submit the contact form
Verify form validation errors are visible
Verify the form is not submitted
